name: Colonial Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Colonial Beach?
answer_short: Only on designated streets posted 25 mph or less. Colonial Beach bars golf carts from State Route 205 except a marked crossing. That street list is not on this map yet, so plain golf carts stay red except a tagged cart path.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Colonial Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on State Route 205?
faq.a: No. You may cross it only at a crossing the town and VDOT have marked.
